# Direct dependencies of the MongoDB store module (store/mongo).
# Users who choose this store download these; everyone else never does.
#
# Format: <module path>  # <why it is needed>

github.com/MogRex-Limited/wardn   # The core library (replaced with ../.. until the first release).
go.mongodb.org/mongo-driver/v2    # The official MongoDB driver for Go, maintained by MongoDB Inc.
